correction.reason: Eurostat total-economy productivity metadata for nama_10_lp_ulc defines nominal labour productivity per person employed as NLPR_EMP. The NLPR_PER identifier cited in v0.2.0 belongs to regional productivity tables and was incorrectly transferred across namespaces.

data_exposure_statement.interpretation: This is a provider-code correction inside an already motivated follow-up study. It does not make the study confirmatory or out of sample.

supports: NLPR_PER is used in regional productivity tables
